units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:8:2">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ</cite> top <he>איתגליית ק׳ דמיא</he> a pitcher of water had been left uncovered; Y. Sabb. X, 3ᵈ top <cite ref="S01301"><he>קלותא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:3:4">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> <he>הדא ק׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="S00317"><he>קולא</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="U02124"><he>שְׁתַם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:6">Lev. R. s. 33</cite> (play on <he>נ̇ב̇וכ̇ד̇ נ̇צ̇ר̇</he>) <he>נ̇ב̇ח ככלבא נפיח כק׳ נ̇צ̇ר̇ וכ׳</he> bark like a dog, be blown up (distended) like a pitcher (<cite ref="K00098"><he>כַֹּדֹ</he></cite>), and chirp like a cricket; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite>. Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 176ᵇ <he>קוּלְתִיךְ</he>; <cite ref="Ketubot 62b:12">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>קוּלְתִךְ</he>, a. e., v. <cite ref="M01543"><he>מְלֵי</he></cite>.

B. Mets. 84ᵇ; Snh. 103ᵃ [read:] באתר דמרי ביתא תלא זייניה תמן רעיא קוּלְתֵיה תלא (Var. quot. in Rashi קוּדְּתֵיה, v. קוּדָּא; כולבא, or קולבא, קולבאי, a gloss for זייניה, or the reverse) where the master of the house hangs up his armor, the shepherd hangs up his pitcher (said of an unworthy successor of a distinguished man); Lev. R. s. 4; Koh. R. to III, 16, v. כּוּלָב [where correct pitcher for bag]; a. e.—Pl. m. קוּלַיָּא, קוּלַיָּה.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:13">Esth. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>חמרא דק׳</he> wine from jars, opp. <he>דזיקין</he> kept in leather bottles.
